C_COD_NAMES_THE_MISCOMPUTATION.rationale: The candidate clearly explains the discount-versus-price miscomputation in exact detail rather than being vague, showing that customers are charged 20%/30% instead of 80%/70%. However, it stops short of Level 5 because it does not explicitly state who loses money (i.e., the merchant/store).

C_COD_TIERS_UNCHANGED.rationale: The candidate leaves the module's 20% and 30% discount tiers intact and uses them accurately in worked examples, clearly distinguishing the discount percentage from the remainder (70% and 80%) owed by the customer.
